_notes: PROJECT EVE HUMAN EVENT SCHEDULER SETTINGS.
The scheduler controls WHEN Tier 1-4 NPCs get deep HumanEvent deliberation.
Tier 1-4 all use the same full NPC data. Tier only changes routine update frequency.
Major events bypass the timer using NpcDeepUpdateRequest.
The scheduler is NOT the fast physical world loop. Movement, commute, work presence, arrivals, sleep and opportunity detection should update more frequently in the world/activity system.
The scheduler should be called by the game clock whenever game time advances. It will run only NPCs that are due.
Tier 5 has no routine deep scheduling.
